proposed_widenings.name: grant_remote_perception
proposed_widenings.justification: Clairvoyance grants the caster the ability to see or hear through a remote sensor location rather than granting a new sense type to the creature (darkvision/blindsight) or scanning for a specific property (detect). No existing atom covers 'use your sight/hearing through a point in space'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space.

proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.allowsMidDurationSwitchAs: "bonus_action"
proposed_widenings.justification: CastTimeEffectModeChoice.allowsMidDurationSwitchAs currently only admits "magic_action". Clairvoyance's mid-duration sense switch costs a Bonus Action, not a Magic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.

notes: Primary blocker: no atom for remote perception through a sensor. grant_sense grants a sense type to the creature; detect scans for closed properties (magic/evil/thoughts). Neither captures 'use seeing/hearing through a projected point in space up to 1 mile away'. Secondary gap: allowsMidDurationSwitchAs needs a bonus_action variant. The sensor itself (invisible, intangible, invulnerable) could be modeled as the attachment anchor using the existing spell_sensor AttachmentRangeOrigin concept, but the perception effect has no atom to hang on it.
